verdict.rationale: The docs show Devin can maintain PRs. With Auto-Fix it iterates on CI failures and review comments, it can act on static-analysis findings from tools like SonarQube, and it handles code migrations and refactors. That covers lint and CI-style fixes and loosely overlaps with dependency work. One hands-on user noted it handles local test setup but adds extraneous changes that can break things. None of the four named tasks is explicitly documented as a first-class workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test authoring, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency-update workflows, plus independent corroboration of lint or test fixes working reliably.
